legs.label: Ternary Bonsai 27B, pure CPU — a model DESIGNED for CPU (recipe leg E)
_why: Ternary weights, ~7.6 GB, built for CPU rather than squeezed onto it — the one
leg that could beat the general-purpose models on this band's own terms.
⚠ BEFORE THIS LEG CAN RUN — it is NOT in the catalog. Smart Add it from HF:
Then set `model` below to whatever catalog id the Smart Add creates.
⚠ `quant` IS PINNED ON PURPOSE. The repo also ships an F16 (53.8 GB); without
the quant filter the GGUF resolver takes the largest file and llama-bench would
⚠ ONLY the g64 file runs on mainline llama.cpp, and only on CPU/Metal — Q2_0
needs the PrismML fork, so there is no GPU leg for this model on our engine.
⚠ KNOWN RISK, verified 2026-07-19: HF discussion #3 reports this exact file
failing to load — "tensor 'output_norm.weight' has offset 357580800, expected
337715200" — on both mainline and the fork. Unclear whether it was re-uploaded
since. Users there also report only ~1-2 tok/s on CPU. If it fails, the bench
records a load failure naming the model rather than producing junk.
